title: Compare ordinary and recorded Spring metadata workflows
description: Now that ordinary ClassUtils initialization decides the original Spring Property obligations, compare it to the previously qualified single-root capture on equal scope. Each trial independently prepares both historical JARs, compiles and binds the original observers, replays both JVM tables, and checks every component and getter. Run ordinary then recorded and repeat in reverse order on one checker. Retain 48 raw selector outcomes, per-side end-to-end and checker times, including replayed parent violations.
expected: Identical historical name outcomes in all four trials, and both elapsed time and raw strict evidence for all six selectors on each original JAR.

steps.name: Both complete lookup routes in reversed order
